title: Juicy Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan dish made with lamb, semolina, and spices, cooked in a flavorful tagine and wrapped in pandan leaves, this keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion, featuring a flambe technique to add a smoky flavor to the lamb.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the semolina flour, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the semolina mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the lamb and onion mixture to a tagine or a large clay pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Add 1 cup of water to the tagine and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tagine from the oven and flambe the lamb with a kitchen torch or under the broiler for 2 minutes.
Wrap the tagine in pandan leaves and serve hot.
